design_quote: We carried out a systematic review and meta-analysis of all randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and quasi-RCTs that examined the merits of managing asymptomatic bacteriuria in KTRs.
k_quote: Five studies encompassing 566 patients were included.
reason: RCT/quasi-RCT-only review pooling antibiotics vs no treatment; the five included studies are all of the eligible randomised designs, so k=5 is ascertainable.
